definitions.short: a loophole (for looking out), to admit light and air
definitions.full: H8260. sheqeph [ שֶׁ֫קֶף ] noun [masculine] frame-work, casing of doors (compare Late Hebrew שְׁקוּף lintel , Aramaic שַׁקְפָא שְׁקוֺף, threshold ); — שָׁ֑קֶף 1Kin 7:5 .
